title: Quasi-copulas with a prescribed sub-track section
summary: In this paper, we consider the quasi-copulas and copulas with a prescribed sub-track section, i.e., with given values along the curve segment connecting the points (x0,0) and (1,1-x0) for 0<x0<1. By employing the technique based on the W-ordinal sum, we provide methods for constructing quasi-copulas and copulas whose sub-track section coincides with a given one. Then, we further investigate construction methods for symmetric quasi-copulas and copulas with a prescribed sub-track section.
